notablePrerequisites: You control an additional creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
easyPrerequisites: You and an opponent each control a creature.
description:
Cast The Last Agni Kai by paying {1}{R}.
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering Avatar Roku, adding six {R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to The Last Agni Kai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
